blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Minimum wage increases in Calabarzon and Central Luzon are next in line for deliberations by their respective wage boards, Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) Acting Secretary Francis Tolentino said Wednesday. “Ito pong napipinto na, malapit-lapit na, nag-uusap na, ang alam ko po eh hinog na hinog na ay yung Calabarzon. Hindi ko lang po mabanggit pa kung ano yung halaga dahil hindi pa naman napa-publish at hindi pa na-confirm ng National Wages and Productivity Commission Calabarzon po,” Tolentino said.
